name: SkyAffiliate for WooCommerce – Complete Affiliate Marketing Solution
author: Siteskyline Plugins

sections.description:
SkyAffiliate for WooCommerce delivers a complete affiliate marketing system for your WooCommerce store. Transform your customers into brand advocates and boost sales with this powerful Affiliate for WooCommerce solution.

Our plugin allows users to easily sign up as affiliates, receive personalized tracking links, and earn commissions on referred sales – all through an intuitive, mobile-responsive dashboard that integrates perfectly with WooCommerce.

Why Choose SkyAffiliate for WooCommerce?

  • Seamless WooCommerce Integration – Works perfectly with your existing WooCommerce store
  • Complete Affiliate Management – Everything you need to run a successful affiliate program
  • User-Friendly Experience – Intuitive for both store owners and affiliates

Comprehensive Features:

  • Secure Affiliate Tracking System – Reliable cookie-based tracking with 15-day attribution window
  • Custom Registration & Login System – Dedicated affiliate signup and authentication
  • Modern Tabbed Dashboard Design – Clean, professional interface for your affiliates
  • Flexible Commission Structure – Set store-wide or category-specific commission rates
  • Automated Commission Calculation – Commissions calculated automatically on completed orders
  • Detailed Reporting & Analytics – Track performance with comprehensive statistics
  • PayPal Payment Integration – Process affiliate payments seamlessly
  • Customizable Payout Settings – Set minimum thresholds and clearance periods
  • Affiliate Auto-Approval Option – Streamline onboarding or manually review applicants
  • Mobile-Responsive Interface – Perfect experience on all devices
  • Secure Implementation – Built with WordPress and WooCommerce best practices
  • User-Friendly Shortcodes – Easy implementation on any page with [SKYAFOWO_dashboard]

Perfect For:

  • Online stores looking to increase sales and reach
  • WooCommerce merchants wanting to leverage affiliate marketing
  • Businesses seeking to build a referral network
  • Anyone looking for a complete Affiliate for WooCommerce solution

Transform your WooCommerce store with a professional affiliate program today!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ‘skyaffiliate-for-woocommerce’ folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to SkyAffiliate > Settings to configure your commission rates and payout options
  4. Add the shortcode [SKYAFOWO_dashboard] to any page to display the affiliate dashboard
  5. Start approving affiliates and tracking commissions automatically
sections.faq:
How do affiliates register for my WooCommerce store?

Users can easily register through the affiliate dashboard by using the [SKYAFOWO_dashboard] shortcode on any page. The registration form is user-friendly and captures all necessary information.

How are affiliate commissions calculated in WooCommerce?

Commissions are calculated as a percentage of the order total. You can set a global percentage in the plugin settings or create category-specific commission rates for more flexibility.

Can I set minimum payout thresholds for affiliates?

Yes! You can set minimum payout thresholds so affiliates must reach a certain earning level before requesting payment, helping you manage cash flow efficiently.

Is there a waiting/pending period for commissions?

Yes, you can set a custom pending clearance period for commissions, giving you time to verify orders before commissions are approved for payment.

Can I automatically approve new affiliates?

Absolutely! You can enable auto-approval to streamline onboarding, or keep it disabled to manually review each affiliate application.

How do affiliate links work with WooCommerce?

Affiliates receive unique tracking links with their username as the referral code. When a visitor clicks this link, a secure cookie is set in their browser with a 15-day attribution window.

Can I customize the appearance of the affiliate dashboard?

Yes, you can use custom CSS to style the dashboard to match your theme perfectly while maintaining all functionality.

Is SkyAffiliate compatible with the latest WooCommerce version?

Yes, we regularly update the plugin to ensure compatibility with the latest versions of WordPress and WooCommerce.
